faq.q: Is Titanium Gas Quick-Disconnect Coupler compatible with fluorine-based process chemistries?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti has excellent resistance to NF₃, CF₄, SF₆, and other fluorine-based plasma chemistries used in semiconductor etching and chamber cleaning. The TiO₂ passive layer forms a stable TiF₄ reaction product that does not spall or generate particles. However, Titanium Gas Quick-Disconnect Coupler should not be used in HF-containing wet processes where corrosion rates exceed 0.5 mm/year.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Gas Quick-Disconnect Coupler?
faq.a: Each Titanium Gas Quick-Disconnect Coupler shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for utility quickdisconnect vacuum.
